info.cls_ename: Department of Environmental Engineering and Science

description.describe_ch: 本課程主要目標是針對環境工程和科學學系的學生所設計的，這個課程主要目的是提供主修環境工程與科學的學生，有關環境的知識和多樣化的訓練。課程內容包含物理化學基礎觀念、水溶液平衡化學、環境有機化學、環境生物化學、膠體化學及放射化學等基本概念。
description.describe_eh: The objective of this curriculum is to provide environmental knowledge and variable discipline for environmental engineering and science major students.  It is the responsibility of those students to face the biggest challenge in the maintenance and enhancement of environmental quality.  The curriculum contents are (1) Basic concepts from physical chemistry (2) Basic concepts from water equilibrium chemistry and pE & pH diagram in water system (3) Basic concepts from environmental organic chemistry (4) Basic concepts from environmental biochemistry (5) Basic concepts from colloid chemistry (6) Basic concepts from nuclear chemistry.

targets.describe_ch: 理解環境化學的重要性
targets.describe_en: To comprehend the importance of environmental chemistry.

targets.describe_ch: 理解並說明環境化學對地球環境生態的影響
targets.describe_en: To comprehend and to be able to explain the influence of environmental chemistry on global ecology.

targets.describe_ch: 知道自何處可獲得環境化學的相關資訊、研究成果，並評估所獲得資訊的適用性
targets.describe_en: To understand where to obtain the related information about environmental chemistry.

targets.describe_ch: 能夠把環境化學知識應用在日常生活中
targets.describe_en: To apply the knowledge of environmental chemistry practically in our daily life.
